effect_description_eng:
When this card would be played, by trashing 1 [Cyborg] or [Ver.1] trait card from your hand, reduce the play cost by 2.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 Digimon card from your trash face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, delete up to 5000 DP total worth of your opponent's Digimon. For each of this Digimon's face-down digivolution cards, add 2000 to this effect's DP maximum.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Greymon] in name or w/[DM] trait: Cost 3
